_: Declared contract debt. Each entry is a missing half of a feature, and the value says who
must deliver it. An undeclared entry fails `make contract`; a declared entry that no longer
applies fails too, so the list does not become a graveyard nobody reads.
Removing a line here is what closes a gap.

missing.GET /api/operator/setup: First-run onboarding (web/src/operator/token-setup.tsx): the gate needs to tell a fresh install (no operator session ever opened) from a returning operator who forgot the token, to show the right screen. Server task: 'Operator setup status route (GET /api/operator/setup)'.

unused.GET /api/connections/callback: Not debt, and the one line here that will never go: the screen never calls it. The OAuth provider sends the browser back to it from the URL registered on its side, so no `/api/…` literal can exist in `web/src/`, and making one up to silence this check would lie to the check. It is the case the header of `api-contract.ts` names: some routes are there for the outside.
unused.POST /api/projects/:p/agents: Agents screen: a "New agent" button (name, role instruction, starting grants). The route exists since 04/09 because there was no way to create a named agent; the screen still only offers the library.
